title: dummvinci-rosetta-plc error-code catalog
description: One catalog file per source device family. Entries map an error/fault/warning code to class, bilingual text, cause, and remedy. NO ENTRY MAY BE FABRICATED: provenance is mandatory, and verified stays false until the entry has been checked against the vendor manual for the installed firmware revision.

source.description: Catalog key used by plc_errorcode_lookup, e.g. 'acs880'

provenance_default.description: Default provenance applied to entries without their own

code.description: Code as displayed by the device (hex string for ACS880, e.g. '2310' or 'A5A0')

verified.description: true ONLY after a human checked the entry against the vendor manual for the installed FW revision
